title: Amnesia
description: You have no memory of your past. You know one thing, though: you may not want to remember it.

submoves.title: Questions
submoves.description:
- Where did you wake up without memory? __str1_0__

- What places, behaviours, or people feel familiar? __str1_1__

- What new identity are you building for yourself? __str1_2__

submoves.title: Shards (+)(-)
submoves.description:
Once per session, when you would mark your last condition (thus **Reaching Your Limit**), you can instead mark Memories and *Have a Flashback*. When you do, you discover an important part of your past; mark 1 XP and the GM advances a Threat.

When you reach 5 Memories, the picture of your past is complete; this Struggle is resolved.

title: Betrayed
description: A dearly beloved double-crossed you, and you've never been able to trust again.

submoves.title: Questions
submoves.description: Who was the betrayer to you? How did they betray you? How can you heal that wound?

submoves.title: Driven & Hurting (+)
submoves.description: You can suffer 1d6 dmg #piercing to ignore all Condition penalties for your next roll. When you **Comfort or Support** (or receive it), you may also ask, "Did I tell them about my betrayer?". If "Yes", the comforted gets an extra option.

submoves.title: Guarded (-)
submoves.description: When you gain Depth with another PC, mark a Condition.
